name: 2026 08 19 CAB August Construction Appeals Board Special Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  BUILDING DIVISION

 CONSTRUCTION APPEALS BOARD SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
August 19, 2026, 6:00 P.M.
Community Room A – First Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Construction Appeals Board on any item on the agenda other than
  a public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Adopt Rules of Decorum by motion.

6.  Adopt Hearing Procedures by motion.

7.  This Construction Appeals Board Special meeting is being held to
  review the Board’s responsibility and establish a regular meeting
  time.

8.  Ralph M. Brown Act and Quasi-judicial hearings presentation by the
  City Attorney’s office.

9.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Construction Appeals
  Board on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Building Safety Division at (310) 412-5294, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5294."

In the event that the Construction Appeals Board Special meeting of
August 19, 2026, is not held, or is concluded prior to the agenda item(s)
being considered, the agenda item(s) will automatically be continued to
the next Construction Appeals Board meeting.

  COMMUNITY ROOM A, FIRST FLOOR,
  INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE WEST MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
